chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and other records
title: Rehearsals and retakes on the Morton dates
summary: They rehearsed two or three times and sometimes had to remake a number.

blocks.x: with her? It was one or two singers, but you see, those things just happened so, you know, they'd come after me. The night maybe something happened, you know, I'd have a day or two and I'd go around and think no more of it. Yeah. Well, when you made those jelly roll records, did you rehearse very long or just run over the tunes in a hurry? Well, no, we'd rehearse about two, three times, two, three times. Several rehearsals. Several rehearsals before we made them. And when you went to make the records, did you have to make them over and over again or just run them off once or twice? Well, sometimes we'd have to make them two, three times, but several times there, I think we got on pretty good without having to go over so many times. They sound so great that they sound like you just played them off once and then they went right off. Yes, sometimes sometimes something would happen where it wouldn't go, it didn't go just right and they'd make them over.
